result.brief: 提出将 LFM2 混合卷积-注意力自回归语言模型转换为掩码扩散语言模型的方案，通过双向门控卷积扩展与 AR-扩散联合训练实现约 1.4 倍加速。
result.reason: Converts AR hybrid convolution-attention LMs into masked diffusion LMs via bidirectional convolution and joint AR-diffusion training; diffusion language modeling is a continuous/discrete language modeling contribution.
